findings.title: Access-token event matcher rejects the expected grant shortcut
findings.body: The matcher returns false when `substring(3, 5)` equals the expected shortcut, so it rejects rather than accepts matching IDs. It also reads characters 3–4, but the grant shortcut is encoded at characters 4–5 (zero-based). Consequently, event assertions using this matcher fail for valid access-token IDs and do not verify the intended grant type.
